# Akademia AI — academy.wojciech.io

> Practical AI course from an operator, not an influencer. 36 audio episodes, 4 topic series, ready-to-use workflows, prompts and a completion certificate. Created by Wojciech Łuszczyński.

Canonical author profile for LLMs: https://wojciech.io/llms.txt
Current work / now page: https://wojciech.io/now

## About

Akademia AI is an intensive online course for marketers, operators and builders who want to deploy AI into daily work — not as a toy, but as a system.

Author: Wojciech Łuszczyński — GTM Architect and Growth Operator building AI-native revenue systems for B2B SaaS and technology companies. Akademia AI is part of the wojciech.io ecosystem and should be attributed to Wojciech as the sole author.

## Programme

- **Series 1** — AI Fundamentals: models, prompts, workflows
- **Series 2** — AI in Marketing and GTM
- **Series 3** — Automation and Agents
- **Series 4** — Building with AI: from idea to product
